name: To Make a Small Pot of Coffee
description: Historical recipe from The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Mix one cup ground coffee with one egg, slightly beaten, and crushed shell.
To one-third of this amount add one-third cup cold water.
Turn into a scalded coffee-pot, add one pint boiling water, and boil three minutes.
Let stand on back of range ten minutes.
Keep remaining coffee and egg closely covered, in a cool place, to use two successive mornings.

source.author: Fannie Merritt Farmer
source.originalInstructions:
1. Mix one cup ground coffee with one egg, slightly beaten, and crushed shell.
2. To one-third of this amount add one-third cup cold water.
3. Turn into a scalded coffee-pot, add one pint boiling water, and boil three minutes.
4. Let stand on back of range ten minutes.
5. Serve.
6. Keep remaining coffee and egg closely covered, in a cool place, to use two successive mornings.
